competences.description: Smites the enemy, removing all beneficial effects and decreasing its Attack Speed and Attack Power for 3 turns.
Attacks all enemies to decrease their Defense for 3 turns. Increases the damage dealt to enemies with no beneficial effects by 100%.

Whenever attacked, deals damage to the attacker with burning flames and recovers HP in proportion to the damage dealt. When attacked by an enemy with no beneficial effects, increases the recovery amount of [Fatal Flames] by 100%. [Automatic Effect]
